project.label: Dam analogs built, fall 2024
project.note: Forest Service decision signed Sep 3, 2024; CPRW lists the project as completed fall 2024. The structures are on Little Beaver Creek just above its mouth; the project pages do not say whether they lie between these two stations.

project.label: Dam analogs built, Sep to Nov 2024
project.note: CPRW's 2024 recap says the South Fork work was done between September and November 2024. The page does not give its location, so it is not certain the structures lie between these two stations.

project.label: Dam analogs built, summer/fall 2025
project.note: CPRW lists Sheep Creek at Sleeping Elephant as completed summer/fall 2025. The samples end in September 2025, so there is essentially no after-construction record yet.
